integrity: The argument is exact. It combines equality in planar Brunn--Minkowski with the classical planar Grünbaum--Winternitz centroid inequality after an explicit affine shear. No computation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The constant \(8/27\) is a proved lower bound but is not claimed to be optimal in the equal-area regime.
Exact equality of all three slice areas is essential to the translation-rigidity step; no near-equality stability theorem is proved.
The motivating preprint is recent, so targeted searches cannot completely exclude an equivalent observation under different terminology.
title: Equal-area three-slice centerpoints improve to \(8/27\)
